BiblicalUsage: Nush means to be sick, or distressed, broken-hearted. In Psalm 69:20 the psalmist says reproach has broken his heart and he is full of heaviness, looking for someone to take pity, and finding none.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God hears the distress no comforter answers, and the broken heart that finds no pity on earth is still known in heaven.
